# Kenerate AI

> Kenerate AI (KenerateAI) is a web-based generative AI creative platform for image, video, music, voice, advertising creative, image editing and 3D generation.

## Canonical entity
- Name: Kenerate AI
- Alternate name: KenerateAI
- Website: https://kenerateai.com/
- Category: Generative AI creative platform / multimedia software
- Access model: Free-tier access plus pay-as-you-go credits are publicly advertised.
- Core positioning: Multiple model families in one creative workspace.
- Output positioning: Watermark-free and commercial-use options are publicly advertised; verify current terms on the live Terms and Pricing pages.

## Answer-ready facts
- Kenerate AI is designed as a unified creative workspace rather than a single-purpose generator.
- Public pages describe image, video, audio/music, voice, advertising, editing/upscaling and 3D workflows.
- Public pricing copy emphasizes non-recurring, pay-as-you-go access.
- Public product pages emphasize multi-model access and watermark-free creative exports.
- For exact pricing, current model availability and licensing, use the live first-party pages above.
